result.summary: Found 1 critical accessibility issue with illegible text contrast in the promotional banner.

issues.description: The promotional banner ('3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') uses white text on a very light pastel green background, resulting in extremely poor color contrast that makes the text barely readable.
issues.suggestion: Darken the banner background color (e.g., to a deep green matching the 'Order now' button text) or change the heading and subtext to a dark high-contrast color so it meets WCAG AA contrast standards.
